# descope_api_resource (Resource)

Manages an API resource in a Descope project: an external API or MCP server that inbound applications request access to.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name for the API resource.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that this API resource belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `uri` (String) The URI that identifies the API or MCP server, used as the token audience. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `attributes_scopes` (Attributes List) User attribute scopes that inbound applications can request for this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attributes_scopes))
- `client_access` (String) Whether clients may be granted access to the resource: `allow`, `deny` or `allowViaPolicy`. Empty uses the project default.
- `connections_scopes` (Attributes List) Connection scopes that inbound applications can request for this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections_scopes))
- `description` (String) An optional description for the API resource.
- `id_jag_target` (Attributes) Cross App Access settings for an external server protected by another authorization server. Inbound applications that exchange a token for this resource receive an ID-JAG assertion for that authorization server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--id_jag_target))
- `permissions_scopes` (Attributes List) Permission scopes that inbound applications can request for this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions_scopes))
- `user_access` (String) Whether users may be granted access to the resource: `allow`, `deny` or `allowViaPolicy`. Empty uses the project default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--attributes_scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `attributes_scopes`

Required:

- `description` (String) A description for the scope.
- `name` (String) A name for the scope.

Optional:

- `optional` (Boolean) Whether this scope is optional. When `false`, the scope is mandatory and must be granted during authorization. When `true`, the user may choose to withhold it.
- `values` (List of String) The identifiers of the relevant permission, attribute or connection scopes.


<a id="nestedatt--connections_scopes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections_scopes`

Required:

- `description` (String) A description for the scope.
- `name` (String) A name for the scope.

Optional:

- `optional` (Boolean) Whether this scope is optional. When `false`, the scope is mandatory and must be granted during authorization. When `true`, the user may choose to withhold it.
- `values` (List of String) The identifiers of the relevant permission, attribute or connection scopes.


<a id="nestedatt--id_jag_target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `id_jag_target`

Required:

- `authorization_server` (String) The issuer of the external authorization server, used as the assertion audience.

Optional:

- `continuation_trust` (Attributes List) Issuers outside this project whose identity-continuation assertions are accepted for this authorization server. Applies to the whole project. At most 20 entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--id_jag_target--continuation_trust))
- `target_tenant` (String) The tenant ID as the target authorization server knows it. Empty reuses the user's current tenant ID.

<a id="nestedatt--id_jag_target--continuation_trust"></a>
### Nested Schema for `id_jag_target.continuation_trust`

Required:

- `actor_client_id` (String) The client ID of the only actor allowed to present assertions from this issuer. Each issuer and actor client pair may appear once.
- `issuer` (String) The https issuer URL of the trusted authorization server, matched exactly against the `iss` claim of the assertion. It cannot be this project's own issuer.
- `jwks_uri` (String) The https URL of the issuer's JWKS. Only keys published there can sign a trusted assertion.
- `sign_algorithm` (String) The signing algorithm of the assertion: `RS256`, `ES256`, `ES384` or `ES512`.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the entry is trusted. A disabled entry is kept but never trusted.

- `values` (List of String) The identifiers of the relevant permission, attribute or connection scopes.
